name: Tomamae (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tomamae town emblem in yellow: three concentric broken rings with a bar at the top.
history: Municipal flag of Tomamae, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 18 December 1967.

features.role: Tomamae town emblem — three concentric broken rings with a bar at the top
